name: dest-flags
description: Destructable flags in war3map.doo after the editor's save: dest-tint-unref.w3x (make-dest-tint.mjs --types=LTlt,LTe1,YT04 --unref: no trigger names any destructable) given flags 0 (and 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 on seven LTlt). The editor writes 2 on every one its script doesn't create (6 where it was 4, fixed height), the script has no CreateAllDestructables; with a trigger naming them (dest-tint) it writes 0 (4 for fixed height) and creates them, whatever flags the input had (2, 3 and 6 included). So flag 2 is the editor's mark 'the game places it from the doo' and follows 'referenced or drops', it isn't input. Studio's script run sets it the same way since 2026-11-17 (branch fix-bugs-dest-cliff: destructables.ts flagsToFollow, map-script followFlags; Studio's steps make the script, w3.script.generate): MATCH, where Studio used to keep what it was given (24 of the 26 differed). The bit 0 of 10 and 12 goes with the terrain editor's open (the playable-area flag).

name: dest-flags-named
description: dest-flags with a text trigger naming every destructable (dest-tint.w3x, make-dest-tint.mjs: 364 destructables, flags 0, 1 and 4): the editor's save writes 0 (4 for fixed height) on every one, its script creates them; Studio's script run clears the flag the same way (2026-11-17, branch fix-bugs-dest-cliff)
